name: Zaal 100
description: Zaal 100 calls itself a stage for unheard sound: amateur theatre, unusual concerts, dance, poetry, exhibitions and small meetings that find no room elsewhere. Private parties and party-political or religious meetings are not booked. Its weekly fixtures include a singer-songwriter night on Mondays, the Impro Jazzcafé on Tuesdays and a jazz workshop on Thursdays, and it runs a monthly gallery and a cheap vegetarian restaurant three evenings a week.
funFact: Listening to the Thursday jazz workshop is free; joining in costs five euros, the same as the Tuesday Impro Jazzcafé.
